name: Stage 19: Ånhammar to Henaredalen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 19, Ånhammar to Henaredalen.
utilities: Official area: Flens kommun, Gnesta kommun.
Ånhammar has official parking behind the wagon sheds, not at the stage board. Brotorp about 1.5 km in is the better signed parking/rest access on the stage.

The start passes grazing land at Ånhammar and the first marker/early markings can be easy to miss in or near the open pasture; use the signed road alternative if animals, dogs, wet gates, or field conditions make the pasture uncomfortable.
Ösjön is the main mid-stage rest/overnight area with shelter, fireplace/grill context, toilet, tenting/lake-water context, and high use. Expect it can be occupied on good weekends.

Västersjön shelter sits just beyond the stage-19 end/stage-20 start area and is the strongest end-of-day overnight node, with toilet, fireplace/grill, tent space, lake access, and unknown-quality water.
Henaredalen reserve rules are stricter than normal allemansrätten: no tenting or fires inside the reserve, pets must be leashed/controlled, and dead spruce after bark-beetle damage can fall in wind.
waterSources: The pump well just after the road crossing is useful but not foolproof: Sörmlandsleden says it may need priming with a little water before it takes. Treat it as an availability point, not tested drinking water.
The Henaredalen cold spring about 400 m before the stage end is the best official refill, but it is still a natural source without a quality guarantee; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.
Ösjön and Västersjön are lake water only. Recent hikers filtered yellow/brown lake water successfully, but the app should never label it potable.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 12 km; Naturkartan lists 12.0 km, local official-GPX-derived geometry is about 11.37 km, AllTrails about 12.1 km, OSM relation 1734723 is topologically connected but has stale distance=13 km and computes around 11.83 km, Äventyrligare lists 11.33 km, and a longer Wikiloc trace likely includes access/detour/noise. Use 12 km as the planning figure.

Route character: Ånhammar pasture and Dunkern views, a 260 m boardwalk over wetland, one of Sörmland's notable oak pastures, Kammarstenen side marker, pump well, Ösjön shelter/viewpoint, Bågberget/Horsbetslet/Stenbryggan natural stone bridge, forest ridges, Övre Horsbetslen, Henaredalen spring, and Västersjön shelter just over the stage boundary.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. 2024 comments mention unclear marking at the very beginning and several boardwalks in poor condition, worst after Övre Horsbetslen; a 2025 blog describes the early wetland boardwalks as newly renovated and later marking as usable, and an April 2026 AllTrails report says conditions were great but still muddy.

Use the local shared GPX vertices as topology nodes for route-building: Stage 18/19 meet at Ånhammar around 59.145903,16.910988 and Stage 19/20 meet at Henaredalen around 59.120929,16.799645. OSM relation 1734723 uses start node 1422895783 and end node 2418258366, both within normal tolerance of official endpoints; treat nearby official/OSM endpoint coordinates as aliases within roughly 35 m, not separate trailheads.

If using OSM relation 1734723, keep official spelling Henaredalen even though OSM tags say Henardalen, and assemble by shared endpoints because ways 985411746, 128436773, 128436775, and 128436770 need reverse traversal. Brotorp, Kammarstenen, Stenbryggan, Solbacka access, Ösjön shelter, the spring, and Västersjön shelter are POIs/connectors, not section endpoints or route members.
Ösjön is repeatedly described as popular. Traneving skipped it because there were people around the lake, while a 2025 blog used it for lunch and filtered lake water.

Västersjön shelter is listed by shelter sources as sleeping about six, with toilet behind the shelter, fire ring away from the shelter, steel grill in front, tent space, swimming, and water of unknown quality. Länsstyrelsen places the shelter/fireplace just outside the reserve, so do not generalize this to camping or fires inside Henaredalen reserve; there is no trash or firewood guarantee.
Public transport is weak. Treat Ånhammar/Henaredalen as car/taxi or through-hike logistics; Dunker kyrka and Mortorp are only distant fallback bus contexts and current service must be checked live.
Skansberget/fornborg alternate and the worst fallen-tree/navigation caveats around that loop belong to Stage 20 context, not Stage 19 mainline. Do not attach that optional loop to Stage 19.

Do not mark fishing as allowed in Ösjön, Västersjön, Henaren, or small stage lakes without checking local fishing rights/fishing-card rules; Visit Flen's free-fishing examples found in research did not include these lakes.

facilities.name: Ånhammar parking behind wagon sheds
facilities.description: Official start/access coordinate. Park behind the wagon sheds, not at the stage board; follow local signs.

facilities.name: Ånhammar grazing pasture / road alternative
facilities.description: The stage starts through grazing land where animals may be present and first markings have been reported easy to miss in/open near the pasture. Use the road alternative if needed, especially with dogs, calves, wet gates, nervous hikers, or unclear animal behavior.

facilities.name: Ånhammar wetland boardwalk
facilities.description: One of the trail's longer boardwalks, about 260 m, starts near the Dunkern wetland. A 2025 hiker report described these early boards as newly renovated, but rain/ice can still make them slippery or awkward.

facilities.name: Brotorp parking and rest access
facilities.description: Good parking/rest point south of Ånhammar about 1.5 km into stage 19. Approximate OSM Brotorp-area pin; no clean parking object was verified, so check local signs.

facilities.name: Kammarstenen
facilities.description: Large glacial erratic about 300 m from the trail along the road toward Ånhammar; easiest from Brotorpskorset where it is signed. Geocaching notes mention a picnic table at the Brotorp/Kammarsten parking context, but verify current condition. Pin uses the more precise OSM stone coordinate close to the official DMS.

facilities.name: Pump well after road crossing
facilities.description: Pump well/spring context shortly after the road crossing. Official note says to prime the pump with a little water if it will not take; treat as untested, field-check function/seasonality, filter/boil if needed, and carry backup.

facilities.name: Ösjön viewpoint/rest rock
facilities.description: Mapped viewpoint/rest area above Ösjön used by hikers for lunch with a view over the shelter/lake.

facilities.name: Ösjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter after about 4 km; one of the stage's most popular rest/overnight places. Shared, free, first-come, non-bookable, and can be occupied. Shelter sources mark water quality as unknown; no trash or firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Ösjön fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Shelter fire/grill context based on Sörmlandsleden general shelter guidance. Use only when current fire rules allow and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Ösjön dry toilet
facilities.description: OSM maps a dry toilet just south of the shelter area, matching recent hiker reports. Verify condition on site.

facilities.name: Ösjön tent and natural-water context
facilities.description: Traneving reports good camp spots around Ösjön, but this is a popular shared area. Lake water only; a 2025 hiker filtered very yellow water successfully, but filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

facilities.name: Bågberget / Horsbetslet / Stenbryggan
facilities.description: Mapped geology/info-board context for the roughly 10 m natural stone bridge between rock outcrops, a key stage-19 geology highlight. OSM also has a Stenbryggan node nearby; keep as POI context rather than a route member.

facilities.name: Övre Horsbetslen boardwalk warning
facilities.description: 2024 official-page and user reports mention several poor/broken or flooded boardwalks, worst after Övre Horsbetslen. A 2026 report says overall conditions were great but muddy, so keep this as a section-specific wet/footing caution until rechecked.

facilities.name: Henaredalen cold spring
facilities.description: Official cold spring about 400 m before the stage end; recent hikers used it to refill. Treat/filter as a natural source with no water-quality guarantee.

facilities.name: Henaredalen stage boundary
facilities.description: Stage-19 end and stage-20 start area near Västersjön/Henaredalen. Public transport is weak; plan car/taxi/through-hike logistics.

facilities.name: Västersjön shelter
facilities.description: Substantial shelter just beyond the stage boundary with Västersjön view; shelter source lists about 6 sleeping spots and reports it holds tight in heavy rain. Older reports said it had seen better days, while a 2025 hiker found it usable and empty. Shared, non-bookable, and no trash/firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Västersjön fire ring and grill
facilities.description: Fire ring a short distance from the shelter plus steel grill in front. Use only when fire rules allow; the shelter/fireplace context is just outside Henaredalen reserve and does not imply permission inside the reserve.

facilities.name: Västersjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet behind the Västersjön shelter, confirmed by shelter source, OSM, and hiker reports.

facilities.name: Västersjön tent, swim, and lake-water context
facilities.description: Shelter source lists tent space, swimming, drinking water/water of unknown quality. Treat lake/source water and do not tent or make fires inside Henaredalen reserve.

facilities.name: Henaredalen reserve rule boundary
facilities.description: Reserve access context: Länsstyrelsen forbids tenting, fires, motor vehicles, loose pets, flower picking/digging, damaging trees or bushes, littering, and disturbing/capturing/killing wildlife or damaging eggs/nests inside Henaredalen reserve. Västersjön shelter/fireplace is just outside the reserve.

facilities.name: Henaredalen dead-spruce warning
facilities.description: Henaredalen has spruce-bark-beetle damage; dead or damaged spruce can fall more easily, especially in hard wind or heavy rain. Avoid lingering under dead trees.

facilities.name: Fishing-permit warning
facilities.description: Ösjön, Västersjön, Henaren, and nearby small lakes are water/access context only. Fishing is not automatically included in allemansrätten; verify local fishing rights or fishing-card requirements first.

facilities.name: Dunker kyrka weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant fallback bus context only, roughly 5-6 km from Ånhammar depending on route. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken service before planning around it.

facilities.name: Mortorp weak bus context
facilities.description: Distant fallback bus context for Henaredalen, roughly 2-3 km away with sparse rural service. Check live Sörmlandstrafiken service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Ånhammar taxi/logistics caveat
facilities.description: Public transport is poor. A 2025 hiker account could not rely on pre-booked ride-app pickup to Ånhammar; arrange taxi/car logistics with margin.
